overloads.semanticRole: Returns the number of the currently displayed page of the parent form (or, if the trailing * flag is passed, of the current page-type subform), or of the form loaded via FORM LOAD.

constraints: The command's own "Description" section text contains a documented 4D doc bug: it says "the command changes the page of the current subform" (copy/pasted from FORM GOTO PAGE), even though this command is a read-only getter (Integer function result). The parameter table's own row ("Returns number of current subform page") and the command name/return type are authoritative; the semanticRole below follows those, not the erroneous prose sentence.

The * parameter is only meaningful when called from within a page-type subform containing several pages: it makes the command report the current subform's own page instead of the parent form's page. When * is omitted, the command always reports the parent form's page.
